description: Record why the person this token acts for will not finish setting up SHIP, in their words: for example no repository yet, no wish to set up model keys or credits, or no time now. Call it only after the person said why. Ask them when get_setup_progress shows setup is not done and they say they will stop. Do not guess a reason. Each call is a new report. A token that acts for no person is refused.

detail.description: The person's own words, short. Leave out names, keys and anything private.

reason.description: no-repository: no code or no GitHub repository to connect. want-templates: wants to start from a template. model-keys: does not want to set up model keys or credits with a model provider. github-access: does not want to give SHIP access to GitHub. too-complex: the setup is too long or unclear. price: the cost. not-now: only exploring, or will come back later. other: anything else, said in detail.

name: report_setup_blocker
title: Report why setup stops
